benchmark_note: Demo value: fictional local benchmark for rain-fed land in INR per acre per year, not an official statistic. Replace with a local quote before relying on it.
legal_notes: Demonstration dataset: farm, owners, contracts, survey numbers and amounts are fictional.
Field boundaries are real 5am.earth (Project Swaminathan) registrations on Cardano mainnet; which farmer registered them is not shown and is not part of this demo.
Revenue records (7/12, Adangal, ROR) are not conclusive proof of title; this check compares your documents with each other only.
Agricultural tenancy, registration and stamp-duty rules differ by state; this check does not assess whether a lease is valid or properly registered.
